text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what should I do...? My rough hands... 
they're just not healing easily.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My classmates were worried about me too, 
so I should refrain from chores involving 
water for a while—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but—someone told me they were 'looking 
forward' to the flowers in the vase—and 
the flower bed needed tending soon too, I 
believe...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No, but... If I make it worse and worry 
you again, that would be— Yet... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still lost in doubt, Curren Bouquetd'or 
let out a quiet, small sigh.
